cards.use: roam the cobbled streets / roam freely，写远足见闻的首选动词
cards.eg: On my first morning in Copenhagen I simply roamed the cobbled streets beside the harbour, following no map at all.

cards.use: cherish a memory / cherish local traditions，观点句与结论段常用
cards.eg: We should cherish the quiet villages before crowds and commerce change them for good.

cards.zh: 持久的；经得起时间考验的
cards.use: an enduring appeal / enduring value，常与 charm, influence 搭配
cards.eg: Fossils have an enduring power: they make us feel how short a single life is.

cards.use: vt. charm visitors / n. the charm of an old town
cards.eg: The charm of a small city often lies in things no guidebook thinks worth listing.

cards.use: grasp why... / come to a grasp of，写旅行所得
cards.eg: Only after walking the same path did I begin to grasp why the poet loved these hills.

cards.use: an impulse to travel / out of impulse，起因段用
cards.eg: Booking that ticket was pure impulse, and the trip turned out to be the best I have ever taken.

cards.use: the transition from A to B，写城市到乡野的心态变化
cards.eg: Hiking forces a slow transition from the noise of the city to the rhythms of the countryside.

cards.use: maximize the benefit of a journey，与 minimize 对举
cards.eg: Backpackers often stay two nights in one town to maximize what they can learn about it.

cards.use: endanger wildlife / endanger local culture，问题段
cards.eg: Feeding wild goats near the trail may seem kind, but it endangers both the animals and the hikers who come too close.

cards.use: be ignorant of local customs / tourists ignorant of...
cards.eg: Tourists ignorant of local customs often mistake a quiet village for an empty one.

cards.use: a casual conversation / a casual glance，写偶遇
cards.eg: A casual conversation with a chambermaid in Oslo taught me more about the city than any museum had.

cards.use: a thoughtful traveler / a thoughtful account，建议段
cards.eg: A thoughtful traveler thinks about the footprint a trip leaves behind as well as the photographs it produces.

cards.use: be passionate about sth.，写兴趣与志向
cards.eg: She became so passionate about fossils that every weekend found her on a different riverbank.

cards.use: sketch a scene / a rough sketch of，替换 draw
cards.eg: He stopped every hour to sketch a birch or a roofline, and the walk quietly became a lesson in looking.

cards.use: a snapshot of daily life，比喻用法比本义更出彩
cards.eg: The night market in Ho Chi Minh City is a snapshot of how ordinary people feed a city of ten million.

cards.zh: 未经过滤的；原汁原味的
cards.use: unfiltered reality / an unfiltered picture，对比社交媒体
cards.eg: Living with a family in a Russian village for a week gives you an unfiltered picture that no tour bus can offer.

cards.use: travel / landscape photography，讨论拍照与体验之争
cards.eg: Landscape photography made this muddy valley famous, although few visitors ever look closely at the rocks themselves.

cards.use: scramble up a rocky slope，远足叙事的动作词
cards.eg: We scrambled up the last slope as the fog lifted, and the whole valley opened out beneath us.

cards.use: fossil beds / a fossil of...，自然与时间话题的论据
cards.eg: In Oregon, fossils of ancient forests lie preserved in layers of hardened volcanic ash.

cards.use: the fossil record shows...，论证深时与变迁
cards.eg: The fossil record at John Day preserves, layer by layer, tens of millions of years of climate change.

cards.use: read the layers / laid down over centuries，比 rock 更正式
cards.eg: Each geological layer on the cliff marks a different age, and together they read like a diary of the earth.

cards.use: protected as a national monument，谈保护与开发
cards.eg: Because the site is managed as a national monument, visitors may photograph the fossils but may not take them home.

cards.use: a shared natural heritage，升华段的世界视角
cards.eg: The loss of one species is a wound to the natural heritage of the whole planet.

cards.use: safeguard cultural heritage，与 natural heritage 对举
cards.eg: The old quarter of a city like Vidin is cultural heritage; once demolished, it cannot be rebuilt.

cards.use: the preservation of old towns，比 protection 更专指原物留存
cards.eg: The preservation of the windmill cost less than a replica would and kept its original timber.

cards.use: develop / earn a living through ecotourism，解决方案段
cards.eg: Villages beside the monument now earn a living through ecotourism rather than cutting timber.

cards.use: exceed the carrying capacity of...，论证过度旅游
cards.eg: When daily visitors exceed the carrying capacity of the trail, the meadow beside it begins to die.

cards.use: a model of sustainable tourism，结论段关键词
cards.eg: Sustainable tourism means that a town can welcome a million guests a year without losing the character that drew them.

cards.use: cut / leave a smaller carbon footprint，交通方式对比
cards.eg: A night train leaves a far smaller carbon footprint than the same journey made by plane.

cards.use: the commercialization of historic streets，批判段
cards.eg: The commercialization of the old quarter turned family workshops into shops selling identical souvenirs.

cards.en: as far as I am concerned
cards.use: 开头亮观点，替换 I think；sb. 可换成 he / they
cards.eg: As far as I am concerned, a weekend in the hills does more for a tired student than a week at the seaside.

cards.use: bring back memories / bring back stories，由景生情
cards.eg: The smell of chestnuts roasting beside a roadside stall in Russia brought back my childhood winters.

cards.zh: 步某人的后尘；继承其事业
cards.use: follow in a parent's / a teacher's footsteps，写传承
cards.eg: Her grandfather walked these trails for forty years, and now she is following in his footsteps as a park guide.

cards.use: word / news got around，写秘境被游客发现
cards.eg: News of the fossil find soon got around, and a road that had been empty for a decade began to fill with cars.

cards.use: a plan / a project gets off the ground，建议与成效段
cards.eg: The village's first hiking festival finally got off the ground, thanks to two retired teachers and a borrowed tent.

cards.use: get the hang of doing sth.，写学习过程与适应期
cards.eg: It took me two days to get the hang of reading the layers in the cliff; after that, the rocks seemed to talk.

cards.use: watch / identify sth. in real time，写科技与导览
cards.eg: The guide used an app that identified each fossil in real time, so even small children felt like researchers.

cards.use: 结尾收束，替换 finally，语气更有总结感
cards.eg: We argued over the map for an hour, and in the end the farmer we asked simply walked us to the gate.

cards.use: stumble upon a place / a fact，远足叙事首选
cards.eg: Rounding a bend in the French hills, I stumbled upon a stone farmhouse that appeared on no map.

cards.use: 否定类比，替换 not at all，论证更锋利
cards.eg: A snapshot is no more a journey than a menu is a meal.

cards.use: a taxi pulled up beside us，叙事转场用
cards.eg: A pickup truck pulled up beside us, and the driver offered to carry our packs to the next town.

cards.use: 旅行收益段的必用搭配，替换 make one know more
cards.eg: Walking alone through unfamiliar streets broadened my horizons more than any textbook did.

cards.use: 替换 experience the local culture，主语性数要一致
cards.eg: She rented a room above a bakery, immersed herself in local life, and learned more in a week than in a semester.

cards.zh: 远离人迹的；不落俗套的
cards.use: 写小众旅行，替换 in a remote place
cards.eg: Our guide took us off the beaten track, to a village whose only road is a mule path along the river.

cards.use: 升级 a lucky accident / by chance，旅行类高分词
cards.eg: The best find of the trip was pure serendipity: we took the wrong turning and met a festival we had never heard of.

cards.use: 升级 walk slowly without a plan；小路、河流皆可作主语
cards.eg: We let the path meander up through the birches and stopped worrying about the clock.

cards.use: 升级 very old / with a long history，形容名城与手艺
cards.eg: In a time-honored bookshop by Oslo's harbour, the owner still repairs bindings by hand.

cards.use: 升级 very beautiful / wonderful，写自然景观
cards.eg: The scar left by the mudflow is awe-inspiring in the way that all old disasters are: silent and enormous.

cards.use: 升级 attract many visitors / interest people
cards.eg: Few things captivate a child as completely as a stone that was once a leaf.

cards.use: 升级 a detail that shows...，举例论证时引出证据
cards.eg: The worn stone step at the door is a telling detail: for three centuries the same families have walked in and out.

cards.use: 升级 almost，常接 impossible / cut off / unknown
cards.eg: After the last bus left, the valley was virtually cut off from the outside world.

cards.zh: （否定倒装）游客与行者看到的从不是同一条街
cards.en: Rarely do tourists and travelers see the same street.
cards.use: 句首否定倒装，升级 Tourists and travelers rarely see the same street.
cards.eg: Rarely do we understand a foreign custom until we have to live by it.

cards.zh: （分词状语）小路穿过桦林，终于通到山脊
cards.en: Winding through the birches, the path finally opens onto the ridge.
cards.use: 分词作状语，升级 The path winds through the birches and it finally opens onto the ridge.
cards.eg: Tucked between two hills, the village sleeps through most of the tourist season.

cards.zh: （with 复合结构）火山灰层层封存五千万年
cards.en: with layers of volcanic ash holding millions of years of history
cards.use: with 复合结构，升级 and there are layers of ash that hold...，描写地貌
cards.eg: We stood there with the sun dropping and the ancient sea floor glowing at our feet.

cards.zh: （as 让步倒装）化石虽惊人，多数游客却匆匆走过
cards.en: Striking as the fossil beds are, most visitors hurry past them.
cards.use: 让步倒装，升级 Although the fossil beds are striking, most visitors hurry past them.
cards.eg: Lonely as the trail was, none of us wanted to turn back before the summit.

cards.zh: （强调句）改变我们的是行走而非抵达
cards.en: It is the walking, not the arriving, that changes us.
cards.use: 强调句型，升级 Walking changes us more than arriving does，结尾点题
cards.eg: It was the chambermaid's quiet pride that I remembered longest.

cards.zh: 旅行从地图结束、脚步开始的地方起步。
cards.en: Travel begins where the map ends and the walking starts.
cards.use: 首段点题句；可用同类句式改写主题词

cards.zh: 越来越多的年轻人放弃拥挤的旅游大巴，改选穿越乡间的慢速徒步。
cards.en: More and more young people are trading crowded tour buses for slow hikes through the countryside.
cards.use: 现象背景句，用于首段引出话题

cards.zh: 就我而言，以脚步丈量的旅程比以照片丈量的旅程更能教人。
cards.en: As far as I am concerned, a journey measured in footsteps teaches more than one measured in photographs.
cards.use: 观点句，首段末或第二段开头

cards.zh: 在俄勒冈的克拉诺区，火山灰层仍保存着亚热带森林的化石，游人读它如读页面。
cards.en: In the Clarno Unit of Oregon, layers of volcanic ash still hold fossils of subtropical forests, and visitors read them like pages.
cards.use: 举例段：用具体地点与细节支撑论点

cards.zh: 正如一位旅行者所写，旅行最好的纪念品是看待自家街道的全新眼光。
cards.en: As one traveler wrote, 'the best souvenir of a journey is a new way of seeing your own street.'
cards.use: 引言句，作题记或论证的收束引用

cards.zh: 游客从车窗拍下大教堂，步行者却留意到六个世纪前刻进石头里的石匠标记。
cards.en: Tourists photograph a cathedral from the coach window, while walkers notice the mason's mark cut into its stone six centuries ago.
cards.use: 对比论证句，while 连接两侧

cards.zh: 正因村子远离主干道，它的方言、烤炉与旧日礼节能存续过去五十年。
cards.en: Because the village lies off the main road, its dialect, its bread ovens and its old manners have survived the past fifty years.
cards.use: 因果论证句，解释现象成因

cards.zh: 旅游虽给历史小城带来钱财，人流却可能磨蚀吸引他们前来的街道本身。
cards.en: Although tourism brings money to historic towns, the crowds may wear down the very streets that draw them there.
cards.use: 让步句，双面分析段的首句

cards.zh: 在哥本哈根，近半数通勤仍靠自行车完成，每日上班路本身就是一堂可持续的课。
cards.en: In Copenhagen, where nearly half of all commutes are made by bicycle, the daily journey to work is itself a lesson in sustainability.
cards.use: 事实例证句，用名城作论据

cards.zh: 我在荷兰一座村庄外偶然遇见了一座任何旅游手册都不曾提到的风车。
cards.en: I stumbled upon a windmill outside a village in the Netherlands, and no guidebook had ever mentioned it.
cards.use: 记叙句，个人经历段

cards.zh: 若想让本土文化延续，就该珍视每座城市的独特，而不是把每条街都变成礼品店。
cards.en: If we want local culture to endure, we should cherish what makes each city different rather than turning every street into a gift shop.
cards.use: 建议句，措施段或倒数第二段

cards.zh: 最终，旅行教会我们对别处的生活保持好奇，并小心不将其毁坏。
cards.en: In the end, travel teaches us to be curious about other lives and careful not to damage them.
cards.use: 结论升华句，末段收束
